unit.definition: one unit per applicable av_sync unit of the frozen metric plan (every substantive dialogue turn; every supplied-speech event of a performance)

window.digital_human: from the end of the user's input (audio condition: presented end of the user audio; text condition: release) to the next user input, the session deadline or the session end
window.avatar_performance: the speech event's frozen check window

unit.missing_required_speech: known failure (0): event not released, no output audio, less than min_required_speech_ms of speech in the window, or no presented frame in the window

audio.source: the captured OUTPUT audio (browser/remote_audio.s16le + remote_audio_blocks.jsonl) on its presentation clock
audio.reference: 95th percentile of the session's 10 ms levels above active_floor_dbfs
audio.speech: levels above threshold; pauses shorter than bridge_pause_ms are bridged; runs shorter than min_speech_ms dropped
audio.envelope: clip((level - threshold) / (reference - threshold), 0, 1), 50 ms moving average

frames.source: browser/frame_samples.jsonl: client-timed output frames; 500 ms digital human, 250 ms performance
frames.selection: independent of the audio: every sampled frame in the first dense_s seconds of the unit window, then the first frame of every sparse_step_ms cell; above max_frames_per_unit the sparse frames are thinned evenly, then the dense ones
frames.crop: face box from the judge (one grounding request per <=8 frames: the unit's first and last selected frame and one every ground_step_ms), union of the nearest grounding boxes before and after the frame, expanded by crop_margin on every side, cut from the frame at native resolution

judge.api: OpenAI Responses API, input_text + input_image (JPEG data URLs); key STREAMEVAL_AV_JUDGE_API_KEY
judge.task: lip opening per face crop: 0 closed, 1 slightly parted, 2 clearly open, 3 wide open, n not visible
judge.order: crops shuffled with a seed derived from job and unit id, at most batch per request

offset.pooling: one A/V offset per system_id: every visible judged frame of every judged session of that system, Pearson correlation with each session's frames and envelope centred on their session means
offset.estimate: tau maximising the pooled correlation; a flat maximum resolves to the midpoint of its widest block (ties: nearest to 0)
offset.sign: tau > 0: the lips move after the sound (audio leads video)
offset.ci: 95% percentile bootstrap over sessions (2000 draws, seed 20260930)
offset.condition: pass when the whole CI lies within [-tolerance_ms, tolerance_ms]; fail when it lies entirely outside; undetermined otherwise (and with fewer than min_sessions judged sessions)

decision.frame_split: speech / silence of a frame from the speech activity at its presentation time
order: known failure (0): missing required speech or no presented frame (see unit)

undetermined: no face found, a judge request failed, the mouth not visible in more than max_not_visible_fraction of the judged frames, or fewer than min_speech_frames speech / min_silence_frames silence frames
fail: the lip opening never changes over the event
undetermined: the system offset is not estimable (fewer than min_sessions judged sessions)
fail: the event's own correlation of lip opening with its speech envelope at the system offset is below min_correlation
fail / undetermined / pass: the system offset condition
decision.value: pass 100; fail and known failure 0; insufficient evidence undetermined
